title: A DROPPED ITEM PINGS YOUR TEAMMATE
why: His pick 48 (drop an item with an auto-ping so the teammate sees it). In a two player raid an item dropped by either window now puts the ordinary ping on the other window, on its map, minimap and in the world. It clears when the pile is taken or after the normal ping time. Solo is unchanged.
now: A dropped item shows as a ping with its name on the teammate map, minimap and in the world until someone takes it.
